title: Chargers stick with Trey Lance and two undrafted rookies on initial 53-man roster

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chargers stick with Trey Lance and two undrafted rookies on initial 53-man roster
sources.description: Undrafted rookies Rodney Shelley and Jacob Spomer earned spots on the Chargers' initial 53-man roster, which doesn't include punter JK Scott.
